interpretation: GSE162516 provides a usable host B-cell EBV-transformation time-course module. It does not by itself establish an MS/SLE EBV imprint and does not include viral EBNA/LMP marker rows in the parsed human gene table. The next grounding step is to score this host module in MS/SLE B-cell or APC data and residualize against generic STAT1/IFN/APC tone.
